summary: Frontend interview practice in progress. Completed the Event Loop / async scheduling cluster. Candidate correctly reasoned through Promise chaining, async/await suspension points, task vs microtask checkpoints, microtask starvation, and task-level yielding. Production reasoning is strong: time-slicing by elapsed budget, responsiveness-vs-throughput trade-off, recognition that chunking cannot preempt one expensive synchronous item, and appropriate escalation to splitting work or Web Workers for CPU-heavy outliers. Current assessment for this cluster: Senior-ready, with only minor precision gaps around terminology and implementation nuances. Next topic can move beyond event loop into React, TypeScript, system design, or debugging while keeping one-question-at-a-time interview format.
